intent: Open an existing Session's Files tree and one real text file, mount the editor and leave its buffer unchanged; count directory/read/stat/diff RPCs, retained subscriptions, bytes and editor work. Companion capture to J9, compared separately.
prerequisites: Pass --url as the exact agent-qa-perf origin-preserving URL for the recorded Session Files route, including its server scope. Authenticate before capture; this declaration does not select an arbitrary Session.

Use desktop width and a repository with available ignore-rule visibility controls. The first visible leaf must be the recorded small writable UTF-8 text file on the online QA Machine; collapse unrelated remembered directories through the UI first. Record Session, root, path, file size and SCM snapshot. If ignore rules are unavailable, All files is already implicit: omit only the two visibility-menu clicks in the recorded external --journey copy.
